notes: Lambda(5,3) >= 399999 (explicit completely additive f: N -> Z/5 with no three consecutive zeros up to 400000, CaDiCaL; same encoding reproduces Lambda(3,3) = 23532 exactly). Lean unit_periodic_has_triple: for odd k no character-type f (periodic on units mod Q) avoids zero triples, r = Q^k - 1 works, so the Lehmer construction for even k cannot extend. Outside Lean: the Chebotarev/Kummer/compactness reduction from Lambda to additive functions and the Python check of the witness.

sources.cite: Lehmer, Lehmer, Mills, Selfridge, Math. Comp. 16 (1962) 407-415

prior_art.note: No lower bound for Lambda(5,3) found in print; the character-type obstruction is elementary and may be folklore.
